fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.35.1 replaces the v0.35.0 RaceMenu BodyUpdate/OverlayUpdate runtime with a direct live-geometry CumOverlays skin repair for both free-standing and physical-furniture scenes. Testing showed RaceMenu could rebuild Body [OvlN] against a small auxiliary geometry (2053 vertices / 19 matrices) instead of the rendered body (18436 / 49), while free-scene proxies could still retain a stale skin binding even when the counts matched. OStim Together now selects the current full skinned body itself, directly copies its vertex descriptor and skin instance onto existing Body [OvlN] geometry, then reapplies the authoritative OCum material state. This bypasses RaceMenu body-source rediscovery while leaving PPA synchronization, scene anchors and OCum equip meshes unchanged.
